newsitem.title: DUBAI: NATIONAL BANK OF BAHRAIN 1996 NET PROFITS RISE.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL BANK OF BAHRAIN 1996 NET PROFITS RISE.

text.p: The National Bank of Bahrain, the island's biggest commercial bank, reported net profits of 13.6 million dinars ($36 million) in 1996, up 31 percent from 1995, the Gulf News Agency said on Wednesday.
In 1995 net profit fell to 10.4 million dinars from 12.3 million in 1994.
The bank attributed the high rise in profits to a 19 percent net growth in interest earnings and a 32 percent rise in other income.
Interest income rose to 19.4 million dinars from 16.3 million in 1995, the bank said, as reported by the official news agency.
The bank, which is traded on the Bahrain Stock Exchange, said earnings had also increased in the loans and advances portfolio as well as in equity investments.
